name: PURPCLAW Complex Agent Harness Canonical Goals

goals.task: Add an API route, wire the UI panel, audit security, and write verification notes.
Analyze a codebase for tangled imports, produce a cleanup plan, update documentation, and verify the result.
Inspect runtime health, identify failing services, propose fixes, run validation, and return one operator report.
Find a performance bottleneck, design a cache improvement, apply backend wiring, benchmark the result, and document the tradeoffs.
Plan a complex productivity workflow, delegate work to specialists, preserve handoff context, synthesize the final answer, and record lessons for the next run.
